children: Vanguard Communication Services ETF (VOX) increased its SpaceX stake by 85.2% in two months, and the holding could eventually reach as much as 20% of the fund as shares fully unlock. According to BeInCrypto, VOX held 632,077 SpaceX (SPCX) shares on June 30 and 1,170,398 by Aug. 31, making SpaceX the fund’s eighth-largest holding. Vanguard has not disclosed the exact current weight, while Alphabet and Meta Platforms already account for 42.4% of the ETF.

title: Vanguard VOX Raises SpaceX Stake 85.2% In Two Months
